levels.title: First Trip
levels.subtitle: A Simple Border Crossing
levels.intro_text: Welcome to the Bureau of Mobility! You are traveling from Valdoria to Norwen for an urgent cheese-tasting symposium. Your passport is fresh and valid, and your bank reserve is plenty. You just need an Entry Visa for Norwen before departure day.
levels.goal_text: Obtain a Norwen Entry Visa and depart before Day 5.
hints: Norwen requires a valid Passport (at least 30 days left on arrival) and a Norwen Entry Visa.
Your passport expires on Day 60, which is plenty! Click 'Apply for Entry Visa' in the Agency Panel, then press 'Depart Now'.

levels.title: Fresh Ink
levels.subtitle: Mind the Expiration Date
levels.intro_text: You are heading to Norwen again, but look closely at your current passport: it expires on Day 20! Norwen border rules require your passport to remain valid for at least 30 days beyond your arrival date.
levels.goal_text: Renew your passport first, then secure a Norwen Entry Visa before Day 7.
hints: Norwen requires your passport to be valid for at least 30 days after arrival. An expiry of Day 20 will be rejected at the border!
Renew your Passport first (2 days, $45), then Apply for Entry Visa (2 days, $50), and Depart on Day 5.

levels.title: Tight Schedule
levels.subtitle: Short-Validity Paperwork
levels.intro_text: You are traveling to Orlanda for a canal architecture expo. Orlanda requires a Passport (valid 20+ days beyond arrival), an Entry Visa, Travel Insurance, and a certified Bank Statement. Watch out: a Bank Statement in this jurisdiction is delicate and if you wait too long or waste days, you will miss the strict Day 7 deadline!
levels.goal_text: Gather all 4 required documents for Orlanda within 6 days and budget.
hints: Your starting passport expires on Day 18, which is less than 20 days after any arrival day. You MUST renew your passport first!
Exact schedule: Renew Passport (2d, $45) -> Apply for Visa (2d, $45) -> Certify Bank Statement (1d, $20) -> Buy Travel Insurance (1d, $25). Total: 6 days (Day 7), $135 spent.

levels.title: Paper Trail
levels.subtitle: Prerequisites & Tight Budget
levels.intro_text: Keshmar's solar summit awaits! Keshmar will not even accept a Visa application unless you ALREADY hold an official Invitation Letter. On top of that, border health authorities demand a Vaccination Certificate and Travel Insurance, and your budget of $145 leaves zero room for unnecessary paperwork.
levels.goal_text: Obtain an Invitation Letter, then a Keshmar Visa, plus Vaccination & Insurance before Day 8.
hints: Do NOT buy a Bank Statement—Keshmar checks your reserve balance automatically without requiring the paper certificate, and your $145 budget needs every coin!
Order: Request Invitation Letter (2d, $30) -> Apply for Keshmar Visa (3d, $60) -> Get Vaccination Cert (1d, $25) -> Buy Travel Insurance (1d, $25). Total: 7 days, $140.

levels.title: Grand Route
levels.subtitle: Multi-Country Corridor Crossing
levels.intro_text: The ultimate bureaucratic gauntlet: traveling from Valdoria to the archipelago of Sunmere via the highland rail hub of Tavik. Because your train routes through Tavik, you need a Transit Permit for Tavik in addition to Sunmere's full entry dossier (Passport valid 30+ days, Invitation Letter, Sunmere Visa, Vaccination Certificate, Travel Insurance, and Bank Statement).
levels.goal_text: Assemble the complete Sunmere entry packet plus a Tavik Transit Permit before Day 10.
hints: Your passport expires on Day 55, which is more than 30 days after Day 10—do NOT waste time or money renewing it!

Get Invitation Letter ($30, 2d) -> Sunmere Visa ($50, 2d) -> Transit Permit for Tavik ($30, 1d) -> Vaccination ($25, 1d) -> Travel Insurance ($25, 1d) -> Bank Statement ($20, 1d). Total: 8 days (Day 9), $180.
